pages.title: Command Framework and Registration
pages.purpose: How urfave/cli v1 apps are assembled: init()+command.Register pattern, command groups, hidden/beta namespaces, flag conventions in flags/, usage templates, plugin fallback for unknown commands.
instructions: Cover stringifyFlag/help customization and the app.Action plugin resolution.
Trace one concrete registration example end to end.

pages.title: Configuration, STEPPATH, and Contexts
pages.purpose: Persistent CLI state: STEPPATH layout, contexts.json and defaults.json, step context subcommands, ca-url/root/fingerprint flag resolution and validation, --config flag.
instructions: Note that STEPPATH mechanics live in cli-utils/step; cite this repo's call sites.
Show precedence between flags, context profile values, and defaults where the repo establishes it.

pages.title: System Architecture Overview
pages.purpose: Ownership boundaries and dependency map: binary entrypoint, internal/cmd root app, command packages, cli-utils split, go.step.sm/crypto and certificates dependencies, plugin escape hatch.
instructions: Distinguish what lives in this repo vs imported smallstep modules; state uncertainty where module internals are not in-tree.
Explain control flow from main() to a subcommand action, error/exit-code handling, STEPDEBUG, and the panic handler.

pages.title: ACME and OAuth Flows
pages.purpose: ACME certificate enrollment (standalone/webroot challenges, acmeutils) and the step oauth client (authorization code, device, OOB, JWT-bearer flows) that feeds OIDC provisioners.
instructions: Cite the challenge-serving mechanics and how OAuth id/access tokens become provisioner tokens.

pages.title: CA Enrollment, Token, and Signing Flows
pages.purpose: Core data/control flow for requesting certs from step-ca: token flows, provisioner selection and token generation, CertificateFlow, online ca client vs OfflineCA, sign/renew/revoke/rekey, admin client auth.
instructions: Cover OfflineCA singleton behavior and password-file handling.
Diagram the OTT lifecycle: token claims, validity bounds, audience, x5c/renew special cases.

pages.title: SSH Certificate Workflows
pages.purpose: SSH subsystem: user/host key and cert generation, login, renew/revoke/rekey, proxycommand, check-host, agent integration, ssh config rendering.
instructions: Explain how SSH tokens reuse the token flow and how the agent is used in login/proxycommand.

pages.title: X.509 and Crypto Toolkit
pages.purpose: Offline crypto surface: step certificate (create/inspect/sign/verify/bundle/install/p12) profiles and templates, step crypto JWT/JWS/JWE/JWK, KDF, hash, nacl, OTP, key generation defaults.
instructions: Explain profile/template mechanism (x509util) and --set/--set-file template data plumbing.
Note the pemutil.WriteFile / jose.PromptPassword hooks installed in newApp.

pages.title: Change Guide: Add a New Command
pages.purpose: Focused maintenance recipe: create command package with init()/command.Register, wire flags via flags package, STEPPATH/CA client helpers, docs/usage text, CHANGELOG requirement, tests.
instructions: Sequence the steps with exact file patterns to copy and commands to run.

pages.title: Change Guide: Support a New Provisioner Type
pages.purpose: Focused maintenance recipe for token generation: extending token_generator.go generate switch, provisioner filters in token_flow.go, token/provision package, and paired tests.
instructions: State clearly that provisioner types are defined in the certificates module and how the CLI consumes them; cite the switch/dispatch in token_generator.

pages.title: Build, Packaging, and Release Pipeline
pages.purpose: How step is built and shipped: Makefile targets and version ldflags, goreleaser, Dockerfiles, deb packaging, install scripts, cosign key, GitHub workflows.
instructions: Document CGO/platform knobs (CGO_OVERRIDE, GOOS_OVERRIDE, MIPS special case) and version resolution order in the Makefile.

pages.title: Renewal Automation and systemd Units
pages.purpose: Long-lived operations: step ca renew daemon mode and ssh renew/needs-renewal, plus the shipped systemd timer/service units and their redirect contract.
instructions: Ground daemon scheduling semantics (renew-period, expires-in, exec, pid, signal) in the command source.

pages.title: Testing Strategy
pages.purpose: How to verify changes: colocated unit tests, go-internal testscript integration suites with txtar testdata, help/golden tests, openssl-jwt.sh, make test/race/lint, CI entry points.
instructions: Explain how a new command gets covered (txtar files, help test) and the mocking style (assert/testify) used in unit tests.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.purpose: Practical entry point: build, run, and test the step CLI locally; minimal CA workflow demo; where to look for deeper topics.
instructions: Ground every command example in a checked-in file (Makefile targets, docs, tests).
Keep it task-routed: short sections linking to deeper pages.
